description: This file contains React components and utility functions for handling links, navigation, and URL parameters within the HTML report of Playwright test results. It includes components for links, project links, attachment links, trace links, and URL parameter management.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that renders children based on a predicate evaluated against URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component for rendering a styled clickable link that handles navigation.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component for linking to a project with query filtering.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component for rendering links to test attachments, supporting download and preview.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component for linking to trace attachments related to test results.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Context provider for managing URL search parameters.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Function to programmatically change the browser URL and dispatch a popstate event.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: Hook to access URL search parameters.

methods.name: generateTraceUrl
methods.description: Function to generate a URL for trace attachments.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook to handle scrolling to an element when it is anchored via URL.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Hook to determine if a given element is currently anchored.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Function to generate a URL hash for a specific test result and optional anchor.
